core_obligations: Case of sheaves of sets (proof lines 6729-6740): the author shows that the pushforward along the closed immersion is fully faithful and identifies its essential image with the sheaves whose restriction to the complement of Z is a singleton, using the description of the etale site of X in terms of Z and its complement.

Case of abelian sheaves (proof lines 6740-6750): the same argument with supports identifies the essential image with the abelian sheaves whose support is contained in Z, and shows that the inverse image is a left inverse to the pushforward in both cases.
proof_roadmap: Describe a sheaf on X_etale by its restriction to Z and to the complement.
Show the pushforward is fully faithful and compute its essential image in the case of sheaves of sets.
Repeat the argument with supports for abelian sheaves, and record that the inverse image is a left inverse.
difficulty_reason: The proposition describes the pushforward along a closed immersion: it is fully faithful on sheaves of sets with essential image the sheaves whose restriction to the complement is a singleton, and fully faithful on abelian sheaves with essential image the sheaves supported in Z, the inverse image being a left inverse in both cases (statement lines 6701-6727). The proof treats the case of sheaves of sets first, using the description of a sheaf on X_etale by its restrictions to Z and to the complement (proof lines 6729-6740), and then the abelian case through the notion of support (proof lines 6740-6750), which also yields the statement about the inverse image. The non-formal content is the description of the essential image in both settings. The claim is H2: two parallel arguments, both written out.
